newsitem.title: USA: Reddi Brake agrees to sell assets.
newsitem.headline: Reddi Brake agrees to sell assets.

text.p: Reddi Brake Supply Corp said it reached definitive agreement with privately-owned Express Parts Warehouse Inc to sell to the operating assets of Reddi Brake Supply Company Inc, its operating subsidiary now in Chapter 11 bankruptcy, for about $6.2 million.
A motion was filed with a U.S. Bankruptcy Court requesting approval of the sale and a hearing has been set for May 21, Reddi Brake said. The sale is subject to court approval.

Express Parts Warehouse has agreed to pay about $6.2 million in cash for warehouse and headquarters assets, including inventory, accounts receivable, vehicles, fixtures and equipment, and the name "Reddi Brake," it said.
Under agreement, Reddi Brake Supply Co would sell substantially all its assets except for two notes with face values of about $1.8 million, the company said.
Reddi Brake Supply Co went into Chapter 11 bankruptcy on March 17, 1997 and immediately suspended operations, it said.
